title: Named After a Symptom
sentences: Bubonic plague is named after one horrifying symptom.
A swollen lymph node in the groin, the armpit or the neck.
Some grew as large as an egg and turned black.
The word comes from the Greek for groin.
Many victims died within a week of falling sick.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
